kcp.platform_name AS platformName, kcp.platform_account_id AS platformAccountId, kcp.platform_account_name AS platformAccountName, kcp.follower_count AS followerCount, kcp.homepage_url AS homepageUrl, kcp.remark AS platformRemark
mapper.select:
SELECT
,
FROM kol_partner_info kpi LEFT JOIN Kol_cooperation_platform kcp ON kpi.id = kcp.main_id AND kcp.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} AND kpi.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
kpi.create_time desc
select approve_status, count(id) from kol_partner_info where is_deleted = false group by approve_status

SELECT kpi.ID, kai.ID AS addressId, kai.country_id AS countryId, kai.country_name AS countryName, kai.province AS province, kai.city AS city, kai.district AS district, kai.detail_address AS detailAddress, kai.contact_person AS contactPerson, kai.email AS email, kai.phone AS phone, kai.zip_code AS zipCode, kai.is_default AS isDefault, kai.remark AS remark FROM kol_partner_info AS kpi INNER JOIN kol_address_info AS kai ON kpi.ID = kai.main_id AND kai.is_deleted = FALSE AND kai.disabled = FALSE WHERE
kpi.id = #{params.id}
( kai.country_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.searchKeyword}, '%') or kai.province LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.searchKeyword}, '%') or kai.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.searchKeyword}, '%') )
AND kpi.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY kai.is_default desc, kai.create_time desc
